jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Event

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "createdAt": {
      "type":      "string",
      "format":    "date-time",
      "goType":    "time.Time",
      "goImports": ["time"]
    }
  }
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/eventpkg

go 1.27
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// An optional field with an explicit goType must still get omitzero.
// A zero Event therefore marshals without the createdAt member.
func TestEvent_OptionalGoTypeOmitsZero(t *testing.T) {
	out, err := json.Marshal(Event{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal zero: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `{}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal zero = %s, want {}", out)
	}

	e := Event{CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, time.UTC)}
	out, err = json.Marshal(e)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal set: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `{"createdAt":"2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"}` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal set = %s", out)
	}
}
